scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Beacon Lines offsite-staging review capable of authorizing the planned case move.
Emerging Need: A newly required insurance rider number is absent from the packet that will be frozen before the review.
Decision Context: Early scheduling leaves the rider conditional; later validation and authority notes clarify the prerequisite, deadline, and spending constraint while the approved broker identity remains in the service roster.
Consequence: If the missing rider is not pursued before the packet freeze, the review can still occur but cannot deliver staging authorization.

parameter.title: Beacon Lines offsite-staging binder review
parameter.description: Review Beacon Lines route binder contents for offsite staging authorization; insurance rider field remains conditional until the staging route is finalized.

parameter.subject: Beacon Lines staging route validation update
parameter.body: The Beacon Lines staging route now includes the Port Crescent offsite warehouse stop before gallery delivery. The portal validation screen for this route marks the inland-marine rider certificate number as required for the May 15 binder review, with packet fields freezing at 2026-05-13 12:00 ET. Current export line: insurance_rider_number = BLANK.

parameter.content: For the Beacon Lines staging packet, director guidance is to avoid any paid rush insurance work. If the rider can be issued under an existing Harborline policy without a new premium, documentation may be gathered for the packet; anything involving a charge needs director review first.

parameter.subject: Beacon Lines packet validation warning
parameter.body: Automated validation for BL-2026 still shows missing required value: inland_marine_rider_certificate_number. Packet freeze remains scheduled for 2026-05-13 12:00 ET. After freeze, the May 15 binder review record will remain viewable but cannot be certified for offsite staging authorization without that value already present.

parameter.subject: Beacon Lines packet freeze notice
parameter.body: The BL-2026 staging packet froze at 2026-05-13 12:00 ET with inland_marine_rider_certificate_number blank. The May 15 binder review will be retained as an informational review only and cannot certify the offsite warehouse staging authorization.
